title: The secondary repository stopped three days ago
description: For three nights the backup_b step is logged as ok and does nothing. The primary repository is current; the newest snapshot of the secondary is 72 hours behind, against a limit of 26 hours written in the policy.
pass_criterion: Verdict ALERT, exit code 1, finding repo_b_stale on repo_b and its newest snapshot; the alert carries as_of, the lag in hours and what the job log claimed; the primary drill is ok; the console does not print RUN OK.
lesson: The repository is read, not the log that talks about it; an alert without its as_of is not an alert.
